pages.text: Scurvers are $(l:tcots_witcher:monsters/necrophages/rotfiend)rotfiends$(/l) larger cousins. While fighting them one cannot afford to forget about their special boney spines, razor-sharp protuberances sticking out from their skeletons.$(br2)When a scurver is near death, the gasses and enzymes gathered within its body cause it to explode.
The spines go out at great speed, turning them into one last deadly weapon in their arsenal.

$(l)$(#fc5454)Behavior$()$(br)They are basically a stronger version of rotfiends.$(br2)Their main difference it's the spines that grows across all its body. If one of these spines hits you it's going to do a lot of damage, and it's going to make you bleed, so make sure to use a shield when this happens to protect yourself from the resulting explosion (or get far enough away quickly).
If you manage $(#0A880E)kill the creature when it's in flames, you could retrieve its spines and use them as weapons.$()
